4770-5301-6006-7296.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

643-5686-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
643-5686-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Maskwood Nexus, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat from step 3.

147-5929-8198.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Trystan's Command
147-5929-8198.description:
Cast Trystan's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Trystan's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Trystan's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-5929-8198.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

4871-6291-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token due to Stridehangar Automaton.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

3532-3949-5078-7913.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3949-5078-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Kappa Cannoneer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kappa Cannoneer.
Repeat.

4399-4518-5070-5998.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Angelic Chorus trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Angelic Chorus trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4518-5070-5998.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

4399-4770-5998-6719.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Grand Arbiter Augustin IV.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Dazzling Angel trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dazzling Angel trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-5998-6719.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1778-1927-4336-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-1927-4336-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

5147-7430--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat
5147-7430--5.notes: Each loop, Gorma will place an additional +1/+1 counter on the persist creature compared to the previous loop. This'll eventually result in both the persist creature and Gorma having infinite +1/+1 counters on them.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4350-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Butcher Ghoul
When Butcher Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Butcher Ghoul enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
4350-6798-6972.notes: If Butcher Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

240-643-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Maskwood Nexus, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-643-5256.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

372-1987-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1987-7487.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

3490-5231-5468-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.

The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2099-6972-7159.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

341-2034-2048-4871-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Umori.
Repeat.

2661-3692-7057.description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {U}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Resolve the first Aethersnipe trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Aethersnipe trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat.

3490-4659-6097-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4659-6097-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.

Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

465-719-3742-4251-6965.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

5189-5231-6872.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control
5189-5231-6872.description:
Activate Ghave by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
When the creature token dies, Lord Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Ghave.
Repeat.

1496-2034-4593-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
1496-2034-4593-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

104-1496-4186.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-1496-4186.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1350-4010-4927-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1350-4010-4927-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

3602-5231--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3602-5231--5.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

224-4102-6133.notablePrerequisites:
Avenging Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Psionic Gift attached to Avenging Druid.
224-4102-6133.description:
Activate Avenging Druid by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Avenging Druid triggers, causing you to reveal a land card from your library and put it onto the battlefield, and put all other cards revealed this way into your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Avenging Druid.
Repeat until no lands remain in your library and/or your library is empty.

2018-2511-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2018-2511-2946-4871.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Cult Conscript from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from steps 1 and 5, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Extraction Specialist.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Extraction Specialist.
When Extraction Specialist dies, Saffi triggers, returning Extraction Specialist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Extraction Specialist enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 2, causing target player to mill cards equal to Extraction Specialist's power.
Repeat.

2034-2584-3490-4016.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
2034-2584-3490-4016.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Pandemonium triggers, dealing 1 damage to Snapping Sailback.
Snapping Sailback triggers, holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Snapping Sailback trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Servo tokens.

147-914-1860-2332.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
147-914-1860-2332.description:
Activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Cast Step Through by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Step Through, targeting Dockside Extortionist and Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Step Through, returning Dockside Extortionist and Dualcaster Mage from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Repeat from step 6.

717-1742-2035.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding Gollum, adding {B}.
Bone Miser's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Gollum by paying {B} and sacrificing the Zombie, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

549-1558-3598.notablePrerequisites:
Rapacious One does not have summoning sickness.
Rapacious One can not be blocked.
549-1558-3598.description:
Declare Rapacious One as an attacker.
When Rapacious One deals combat damage, it triggers, creating at least five 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by sacrificing five Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

678-951-2972.description:
Cast Shivan Devastator by paying {R}.
Shivan Devastator enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Enduring Renewal and Ganax triggers.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Shivan Devastator from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

914-1703-2034.notablePrerequisites:
Fool's Demise attached to Dockside Extortionist.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1703-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Fool's Demise first and second abilities.
Resolve the first Fool's Demise trigger, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}.
Cast Fool's Demise by paying {4}{U}, attaching it to Dockside Extortionist.
Repeat.

215-914.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
215-914.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate four Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.
